t: A tiny low-power chip for Zigbee, Thread and Bluetooth smart home gadgets.
steps: Buy an ESP32-H2-DevKitM-1 from Adafruit, or an Olimex or Waveshare H2 board.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the ESP32 board package in the Boards Manager.
Choose the ESP32-H2 board in the Tools menu.
Plug in a USB-C cable and upload the Blink example to light the RGB LED.
Open the Zigbee light example and follow its setup notes.
Upload it and pair it with your hub or Zigbee2MQTT.
Try the Zigbee temperature sensor example next.
meta: Open Board. From $10. A few stores.
